title: Chapter 549 - 549 Meeting Li Xinyue Again; Introduction!
content:
Chapter 549 - 549 Meeting Li Xinyue Again; Introduction!

Chapter 549 - 549 Meeting Li Xinyue Again; Introduction!

549 Meeting Li Xinyue Again; Introduction!

Nation Daily: [Defamation and slander are both crimes! Recently, Tang Yuan from Jiangbei University has been using the internet to slander others. Little did he know that he’s already embarked on the path of crime! I hope everyone will take this as a warning!]

This article was not long.

However, it made everyone believe that Tang Yuan was framing Lin Fan!

This was the Nation Daily!

It was the fairest and most loyal news outlet!

Li Ruo: [So that’s how it is. I was almost deceived by Tang Yuan.]

Chen Niannian: [I hope that this matter can be dealt with seriously to prevent such things from happening again.]

Xu Yue: [He took advantage of everyone’s sympathy. This kind of person is very despicable.]

Qiankun Tianxia: [I saw someone say something. The person who’s framed is a rich second-generation heir. He’s delusional, right?]

The Wind Blows Over: [If he’s committed a crime, the Jiangbei Police Department and Jiangbei University can’t let him off so easily!]

Love You for Ten Thousand Years: [Severe punishment!]

Wood-Type: [Yeah, severe punishment!]

…

It was nighttime.

Tang Yuan looked at his increasing number of followers and smiled widely.

However, before he could smile for long, he was called to the meeting room by the leaders of Jiangbei University.

There, he saw the professor, the director, the dean… Even the chancellor!

Tang Yuan had always thought that he would not be ordinary in the future. He would either become a senior official of a listed company or a big internet celebrity!

However, when he saw so many leaders, he could not help but be at a loss.

It was very stressful to answer questions in front of so many leaders.

In addition to the professional and strict review, as well as the concrete evidence…

Not long after, Tang Yuan told them everything.

Therefore, Jiangbei University punished Tang Yuan that day.

According to the chancellor and the others, the impact of this incident was very bad.

If Tang Yuan did not admit his mistake, he would be expelled.

This was not the end!

Tang Yuan had just returned to his dormitory when two police officers rushed over.

“Hello, are you Mr. Tang? You’re suspected of slandering others. Please come with us.”

On the first day of school, Tang Yuan was given a major demerit and was kept on probation.

Furthermore, he had to spend the entire night at the police station…

He became extremely haggard, and his heart was filled with endless regret.

…

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

Of course, even if he knew, he would not care.

The next day, he arrived at Jiangbei University as usual.

Last night, Xia Bing and Xia Xue already knew what had happened to Tang Yuan. They were very happy and constantly smiling.

They had some involvement in yesterday’s incident.

This made them feel like they had helped Lin Fan, so they were very happy.

A few days passed in a flash.

In the blink of an eye, it was Saturday.

During the summer break, Lin Fan stayed at home in Qing City. It was very warm and comfortable.

However, it lacked the bustling experience of a big city.

After breakfast, Lin Fan went to the financial street of Jiangbei. He looked at the tall buildings on both sides of the road and experienced the bustling city that he had not seen in a long time.

…

Today, Wang Tong and Li Xinyue went shopping on the financial street.

Originally, Li Xinyue did not want to go out.

However, since Wang Tong had invited her again and again, Li Xinyue could not keep refusing.

After all, the two of them were roommates, after all. It would not be good if their relationship was too strained.

On the second day of school, under Wang Tong’s suggestion, four of them held a dinner party.

Wang Tong happened to run into her boyfriend and his two friends.

Hence, they decided to eat together.

After that, Wang Tong often praised one of the men called Tan Jiayou in front of Li Xinyue.

It was said his family’s assets were close to 100 million yuan, he lived in a big villa, drove a supercar, and so on.

She even asked Li Xinyue what she thought of him.

Li Xinyue was not a child who did not know anything.

She naturally understood what Wang Tong meant.

The other party wanted to matchmake her and Tan Jiayou.

Hence, Li Xinyue said straightforwardly, “I have someone I like.”

At this point…

Wang Tong stopped talking about such topics.

Today, after Wang Tong’s invitation, Li Xinyue agreed to go shopping together. She did not expect to meet Tan Jiayou, who was dressed in a suit.

It was a coincidence.

Two coincidences.

How could there be so many coincidences in this world?

Li Xinyue was not happy, but she did not want to say anything.

However, Tan Jiayou was like a mangy dog, sticking close to her and constantly looking for a topic to talk about.

This annoyed Li Xinyue, and she frowned. Just as she was about to find an excuse to leave, she looked up and saw a tall and handsome figure.

It was Lin Fan!

At this moment, Li Xinyue’s brows instantly relaxed. Her face was very pretty, and now it looked extremely brilliant.

When Lin Fan invited Chief Physician Li to treat Li Xinyue’s father who was suffering from a tumor, Li Xinyue’s heart went through many changes.

At first, she was grateful. But as time passed, Lin Fan seemed to occupy a bigger position in her heart.

When Li Xinyue was alone, the image of Lin Fan chatting with her father would often appear in her mind. The image of Lin Fan smiling, the image of Lin Fan opening the door…

Gradually, Li Xinyue knew that she had fallen in love with Lin Fan.

She wanted to be with Lin Fan forever.

It was this mentality that made Li Xinyue study hard last semester. In the end, she entered Jiangbei University with excellent results.

Ever since she came to Jiangbei University, Li Xinyue had been looking forward to meeting him.

Today, it finally became a reality!

Li Xinyue called out in a trembling voice, “Brother Lin!”

Lin Fan smiled and said, “Xinyue.”

Then, Li Xinyue ignored Tan Jiayou who was nagging and ran toward Lin Fan.

During the college entrance exam, Lin Fan realized that Li Xinyue had already become slim and graceful.

After the summer break, Lin Fan realized that Li Xinyue’s face, waist, and thighs had not changed. However, her neck had elongated.

“You’re at Jiangbei University?” Lin Fan asked.

“Yes, yes!” Li Xinyue nodded her head vigorously. As she spoke, her beautiful eyes shone with a brilliant light. Her entire face was flushed red with excitement.

Tan Jiayou’s face darkened when he saw this.

Wang Tong, who was beside him, asled, “Xinyue, is this your friend? Why didn’t you introduce us?”

After a pause, she said, “Hello, I’m Wang Tong from Xinyue’s university.”

“This is my boyfriend’s friend, Tan Jiayou.”

As she introduced him, her eyes were sizing him up.

Lin Fan said, “Hello, I’m Lin Fan. I’m Xinyue’s senior from high school.”

Even though Lin Fan didn’t like this kind of scrutiny, the other party was Li Xinyue’s friend after all. He could not make things too ugly.
